column1: # Every commit the forks carry over their upstream, and why (ci/fork-upkeep.py reads this file).
#   fork     microsandbox, libkrun, russh, imago or libkrunfw
#   label    permanent = a Puddle feature or policy that upstream may never take; carried for good
#            candidate = a fix or feature upstream could take; carried until upstream has it
#   replay   pick  the weekly dry run cherry-picks it on upstream's tip
#            regen the fork's release job rewrites it (dependency pins, version); not replayed
#   subject  the commit subject; a trailing * matches a prefix
#   why      one line: what it is and why it has this label
# A commit with no line here, or a line that matches no commit, makes the weekly job report it.
# Filing a candidate upstream is a person's decision (upstream-issues is where drafts are prepared).
